name: opensearch
description: Explore and query indexed data in self-hosted OpenSearch through its native MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Manage independent self-hosted OpenSearch connections by cluster base URL with Basic authentication, then list indices, inspect mappings, and search indexed data through each native MCP endpoint.
defaultPrompt: List the indices available in this OpenSearch cluster.
Inspect the mapping for an OpenSearch index.
Search an OpenSearch index for matching documents.
